items.reasons: The garments are a flat front elevation inside a closed white box frame, and there is no rail or top plane seen from above. It reads as a display case or wardrobe interior, not a free-standing clothing rack, and the heavy dark outline boxes in the whole thing.

At 1x it reads as a white fridge or cabinet stack rather than an open rack. The lower appliance is a generic grey box with a slot, so it doesn't read as a rice cooker or any clear appliance. The rack's posts and open shelves are not visible.

It is drawn as a solid boxed cabinet with a dark interior holding a blue towel, a white cloth and a stray red vertical stick. There are no thin bars or folding legs, so it reads as an open wardrobe rather than a drying rack, and the wide white base slab is not a lit top plane.

It is a pure flat front-elevation strip of green pleats with only a thin grey cap, and no rail or base is seen from above. It is one tile wide and very tall, so at 1x it reads as a pillar or column, and the bottom white base looks pasted on.

The chain-link mesh sits in a heavy boxed frame with a thick white concrete slab below it, which is a front elevation with no top rail plane. The dense green diamond dither is much noisier than the originals' clean blocks, and it reads as a framed window or screen, not a fence.
It is a one-tile shelf unit with stocked colour-block goods and a yellow POP sign on top. Its outline, shading and density are consistent with mci-cooler, and it stands cleanly on the floor.

The top unit with its small green LED dots reads as a printer or microwave; there is no visible weighing pan or plate seen from above. The white containers and grey drawer below make the whole thing read as a generic appliance shelf, not a scale station.

It is a flat front elevation of a panel with a framed painting, and the top is only a thin white strip with no wall-thickness plane from above. The three black spotlight dashes float detached at the top edge, and the grey gradient base makes it read as a wall-mounted display or TV rather than a free-standing partition.
